sottotitolo:
Three different ways we can work together!

Tailor-Made Travel for those looking for a fully personalised trip, Travel Consultations for those who need expert advice but prefer to plan everything themselves, and Scheduled Group Trips for those who enjoy exploring the world together!

lista.testo: Complete design of your journey, from the first idea to departure: accommodation, experiences and rhythms tailored to you.

lista.titolo: Travel Consultation for those who prefer to book everything independently.
lista.testo:
Do you already have a destination in mind and have gathered plenty of information, but need someone to help you make sense of it all and turn your ideas into a concrete travel plan?

The Travel Consultation is designed for those who enjoy organising their own trips but would like the guidance and expertise of a travel professional along the way.
punti:
Discussion of your chosen destination and possible itinerary options.

Recommendations on transport connections and getting around locally.

Advice on the best time to travel, taking into account the climate and specific characteristics of each destination.
Suggestions for experiences, places and lesser-known areas worth exploring.
A written summary after the consultation, including the main recommendations discussed during our call. Alternatively, upon request, a detailed itinerary that you can book independently.
lista.prezzo: Starting from €50, up to a maximum of €200.

punti: Scheduled departures: dates and destinations planned in advance.
